description: The agent providers this repository may dispatch a run to, keyed by registered adaptor id, each with the defaults a run on it takes (ADR 000004: the manifest declares, an argument overrides). No model is declared here: a model depends on the task, so the caller names it per run.

providers.description: One entry per provider a run may reach, keyed by adaptor id, holding that provider's own options as lib/agents/<id>/options.schema.json defines them. With exactly one entry a run needs no provider named; with several, the caller names one.
